prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1372; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and restricted motion in the right shoulder. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the force of the crash fits the type of soft tissue damage found on examination. Imaging and physical findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to this body region is known from the patient's history. Over five visits, treatment followed a standard course that included rest, a structured range-of-motion program, and anti-inflammatory medication. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as function returned. At the most recent visit the patient had regained most of the shoulder's range of motion with only mild residual discomfort on overhead activity. Billed services correspond to the visits performed, with no duplicated or repeated charges. Continued home exercises and a follow-up as needed were recommended.
